Physical audible observation can arrive before or after transport completion, callbacks may be retransmitted, and the coordinator itself re-enters while awaiting AW38 correlation. A Lane-local staged authority was required to avoid sample mis-correlation, double finalization and silent evidence loss during HQ/iOS device wiring.
